sloka: सुग्रीवस्त्वं च रामश्च यन्निमित्तमिहागताः।तां हनिष्यामि वैदेहीमद्यैव तव पश्यतः ।। ६.८१.२८ ।।
transliteration: sugrīvastvaṁ ca rāmaśca yannimittamihāgatāḥ।tāṁ haniṣyāmi vaidehīmadyaiva tava paśyataḥ ।। 6.81.28 ।।

translations.english: "O Hanuman! You said women should not be killed. But whoever causes trouble to the enemy, action should be taken, said Indrajith."
